study.question:
Observed evidence under the identical frozen seed: baseline-din click AUC0.6555440824 (328.91s); unchanged g0-r0052-block_nonlinear_transfer0.6685268680 (380.66s). The utility model has worse cart/fav/buy AUC than DIN, so it is not a four-task Pareto gain. g1-r0054-canonical_forward0.6659442302 versus supplied_unchanged0.6685268680, and content-hash controls g1-r0060-content_hash_a0.6658821613/content_hash_b0.6660822710, show unsuccessful content-canonical replacements in this recipe. g1-r0063-reversal_average0.6661558657 (584.29s) and g1-r0064-reversal_per_view0.6662125026 (592.97s) do not recover quality despite more work. g1-r0065-details_only0.6662811686 versus compression_only0.6684818197 locates much sensitivity in the detail treatment. g1-r0067-coarse_axis0.6667055158 is a much cheaper sign-quotient diagnostic (384.51s); this unsuccessful replacement does not prove order necessary. g1-r0068-axis_with_sign0.6664435963 versus axis_constant0.6664137638 and g1-r0069-target_with_sign0.6665929416 versus target_constant0.6666401839 do not show scalar sign-bit rescue. g1-r0070-adapter_signed0.6684484331 recovers more of the both-axis/both-signed gap than interaction_signed0.6679319346, falsifying the previous dominant-interaction-route expectation in that seed. Latest g1-r0071-primary_only0.6684190188831848, auxiliary_only0.6665863579361403, both_adapter_sign0.6684484331487273, no_adapter_sign0.6667055157905444 give primary recovery98.3124%, auxiliary recovery-6.8367%, and factorial interaction+0.0001485721. Primary-only minus no-sign is+0.0017135031; auxiliary-only minus no-sign is-0.0001191579. The prior practical primary-dominance rule is met, locally. All successful execution statuses include negative scientific outcomes; no failures are hidden and no unlisted failed-run history is invented. These are controlled same-seed observations, not independent repeated support, significance, a novel architecture or proof of total order utility.

Next falsifiable question: with the interaction and auxiliary adapter coarse inputs fixed to axis, does the signed-versus-axis click-adapter advantage survive removal of only that adapter input's direct gradient into historical values?
study.hypothesis: With interaction and auxiliary adapter coarse inputs fixed to the existing sign-canonical axis, most of the click signed-summary advantage will persist after blocking only the direct gradient from that summary's click-adapter input to historical item/action values. This would support useful forward access through that local route under the tested optimization protocol. If that conditional advantage largely disappears, direct representation-training feedback is consequential, or the intervention perturbs optimization enough to mask forward utility. Detaching this one edge does not remove all order learning or establish a formal mediation decomposition. No novelty claim is made.

study.proposed_difference: Factor S=primary signed/axis coarse input and G=attached/blocked direct coarse-input gradient. Compute original signed and axis signals plus a third signal with only its selected coarse coordinate detached in every cell. Use this third signal only for primary/train/blocked. Interaction and auxiliary routes retain the original axis signal; evaluation returns the original forward signal. No learned parameter, state, input or training-loss change. Define S=1 for signed click-adapter coarse input, S=0 for axis; G=1 for attached direct source gradient and G=0 for blocked. A11=signed_attached, A01=axis_attached, A10=signed_blocked, A00=axis_blocked. Report D_att=A11-A01, D_blk=A10-A00, G_signed=A11-A10, G_axis=A01-A00 and I=D_att-D_blk. Require D_att>=0.0005 before interpreting retention R=D_blk/D_att. R>=0.75 provisionally supports largely retained forward-route benefit; R<=0.25 with a positive I supports consequential dependence on that direct gradient in this recipe. Intermediate/reversed results remain mixed or counterevidence; report every signed effect and absolute AUC, rather than forcing a category. Similar drops in both blocked cells with retained D_blk indicate a general source-training effect. These are predeclared practical thresholds, not significance tests. If the attached bridges deviate materially from their earlier treatments, diagnose parity/runtime before interpreting the contrast; do not demand a performance match as a pass criterion for changed treatments. Frozen-seed exact replays establish implementation reproducibility only. Compare quality/cost against g0-r0052-block_nonlinear_transfer and DIN, never substitute auxiliary mean AUC for click selection. Report click and all task Logloss/AUC, auxiliary mean, total/embedding/dense parameters (expected32192421/31793216/399205, native measurement pending), allocated GPU seconds, train/wall/inference time, examples processed, peak memory, examples/sec and batch p50/p95 latency. Equal parameters and matching forward concatenations do not establish equal measured cost. Report a quality/cost frontier; do not invent an equal-time run or alter the fixed training pass.
predictions: Attached same-seed bridges reproduce the prior primary_only/no_adapter_sign treatments within native implementation tolerance; gradient blocking has no instantaneous forward or running-buffer effect at common weights.
Provided D_att>=0.0005, D_blk/D_att>=0.75; a substantial signed advantage then survives removal of this direct source-training edge.
Both blocked cells retain all downstream adapter parameter learning, original sibling paths and interaction-source gradients; measured capacity is unchanged while backward cost may change.
falsifiers: Failure of any mask, visibility, native parity, derivative-routing or optimizer-ownership gate invalidates interpretation and must be recorded as execution/integrity failure.
D_att<0.0005 leaves no stable contemporaneous practical gap to attribute; report the raw outcomes rather than normalized recovery.
D_blk/D_att<=0.25 when D_att>=0.0005 contradicts the largely retained forward-benefit hypothesis, subject to the optimization alternatives.
A strong axis_blocked result matching/exceeding signed_blocked falsifies local signed utility under that gradient treatment; no history-wide necessity claim is allowed.
alternative_explanations: One frozen seed and one data pass; exact endpoint replays are implementation checks, not independent repetitions
Axis pivot coordinates depend on evolving embeddings and are nonsmooth at ties; detach changes subsequent optimization and shared representations
Other position, curvature, compressed-block and interaction paths remain order-sensitive and differentiable; this is not a whole-history order-invariance test
A blocked path can still read values learned through other paths; absence of a selected direct gradient is not absence of representation adaptation
Source detach may slow one-pass learning or alter feature charts; even a large factorial interaction is not a unique proof of gradient mediation.
Same-seed results can be particular to initialization, one-pass optimization, fixed positional blocks or the benchmark offline visibility assumptions.
